question: Which of the following devices is used to insert a micrometer in the hole of an external cylinder for zero aligning?
solution:
The correct answer is __Wrench__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wrench__ is a tool used for gripping and applying torque to turn objects.
 
• It is commonly used in mechanical engineering and maintenance tasks.
 
• A wrench can assist in the precise adjustment or alignment of instruments.
 
• It ensures that micrometers or similar devices are properly aligned for accurate measurements.
 
• Using the correct tool, such as a wrench, prevents damage to delicate devices and ensures their longevity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Screwdriver:**

 
 
• Used for driving screws into surfaces or loosening them.
 
• Not suitable for aligning micrometers in external cylinders.
 
 
 
• **Spanner:**
 
 
• Typically used for tightening or loosening nuts and bolts.
 
• Can be used for gripping but not for precise alignment of micrometers.
 
 
 
• **Allen Key:**
 
 
• Used for driving bolts and screws with hexagonal sockets.
 
• Not ideal for external cylindrical micrometer alignment.
